falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes below 4,800 on any daily close in next 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The bottom_2024_aug pattern relied on 4,800 as critical support; a close below invalidates the structural floor and suggests the 'bottom' pattern was a bear market rally continuation, not a reversal base

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 25 for 3 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The bottom_2024_aug pattern featured VIX compression below 20 as a key feature; sustained VIX elevation above 25 indicates fear-driven liquidation, not the complacent accumulation characteristic of that bottom formation

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y Treasury yield closes above 4.50% while S&P 500 is below 5,000
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: This combination breaks the 'bad news is good news' dynamic of the bottom_2024_aug pattern, where yields and equities decoupled; concurrent stress in both rates and equities signals a growth scare, not a disinflationary soft landing

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
